title: clidemia trichopetala
intro: Clidemia trichopetala, commonly known as the "Cloud Forest Clidemia" or "White Cloud", is a flowering plant species in the family Melastomataceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes.
